tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i khrus dang sbyin sreg yi ge sdig sbyong thugs rje'i snang gsal bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsakra saṃ ba ra ya/ de la 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i khrus dang sbyin sreg bya tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni rnal 'byor pa 'khor lo bde mchog sogs bla med kyi dbang thob cing gzhi bsnyen sbyin sreg mthar phyin zhig gis 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi sdig pa sbyang bar 'dod pas dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu khebs ldan gtsang mar bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad khar bum pa mgul chings kha brgyan can chu gtsang la bum sman so lnga btab pas gsum gnyis bkang ba'i khar dung chu rdo rje gzungs thag bcas bkod pa'i mthar mtshams 'dzin chu gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor rang gi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas rnams dang sbyangs khrus byed na sbyangs chos spyi 'gre/ khrus kyang byed na de'i nyer mkho rnams bshams/ bdag bskyed yig cha du ma bzhugs kyang / 'dir sa lo chen po'i gsung 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi sgrub thabs nges don zla ba'i 'od zer ltar nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas te skyabs yul gsal 'debs nas/ sgo mtshams ma'i bar yig 'brur gyur/ bar shar gyi byas ma bum par rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zhes pa nas/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du/ bar spyi 'gre la/ pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du sman lnga ni sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ a ā sogs nas/

aṃ aḥ'i bar/ lan gnyis brjod la/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng rin po che lnga/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha nas/ ḍa dha'i bar lan gnyis brjod la/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes de gnyis kyi bar du 'bru lnga ni hūm̐ dang am̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bar 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhin bskyed/ bum pa'i steng gi rdo rje'i lte bar yang 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum de 'dra ba zhig gsal bar gyur/ bum nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su/ zhes sogs yab yum gyi go cha bkod la/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta aḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo bdag dang chos thams cad rnam par dag go /tshar gcig slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ mchod pa/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhuṣ+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta aḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin/ shap+ta'i bar 'gre bas phyi mchod ḍā dril/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā kī ni dza la sam+bha raṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gis bsang mchod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rgyud bskul sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa skya mer mer gang bar gyur/ zhes dang gzungs thag bzung la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo ma bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo ma bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa badz+ra he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa mā ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brgya stong la sogs ci nus bzlas mthar/ mchod pa gong bzhin yang yig brgya gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs sh+lau ka gcig bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/

zhes brjod la dam tshig nyams skyon gyis mtshon nyams chag sbyang ba'i rten khrus zhu na/ ji ltar bltams pa/ sogs sngags bcas spyi 'gre bzhin dang / yig brgya bzlas zhing sku khrus gsol la sku phyis sngags bcas brjod/ yig brgya bzlas zhing sku dang gnas khang mchod gtor sogs la gtor/ yang rang gi sgrib sbyang yin na yig brgya bzlas zhing khrus bya/ gzhan la sbyangs khrus byed na zhi ba dang zhi drag phyed ma drag po'i sbyang ba rnams spyi 'gre ltar/ deng 'dir khrus kyi mnga' gsol ba la/ zhes sogs dang / bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / zhes tshig bsgyur/ skabs thob khrus ni/ khyed rang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i phyag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu'i gang ba'i bum pa thogs te khrus gsol ba tsam gyis khyed rang gi gtso byas sems can thams cad tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad gtsang sing gis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ ji ltar sogs/ 'di ni sogs/ de bzhin sogs/ a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags bcas/ de bzhin phar phyin drug khrus sngags bcas dang / chu bo drug gi sogs/ dri chu drug gi sogs/ dri ma rnam drug sogs kyang sngags bcas brjod mthar yig brgya lan gcig bzlas la/ dmigs yul gyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa thams cad༞ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa thams cad༞ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa thams cad༞ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa thams cad༞ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba thams cad༞ sngags kyi rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa thams cad༞ yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad༞ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad༞

rjes spyod kyi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad༞ za ba'i dam tshig nyams pa thams cad༞ bsrung ba'i dam tshig nyams pa thams cad༞ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig nyams thams cad༞ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad༞ mchod gtor dman zhing 'bags btsog tu gyur pa thams cad༞ dam nyams dang 'grogs pa sogs mdor na dam tshig nyams chag ji snyed mchis pa thams cad༞ nad thams cad༞ gdon thams cad༞ dus min 'chi ba thams cad༞ mdor na 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtho ris dang thar pa byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bkru/ byabs pa ni de'i khar chu bzung du bcug la bum pa'i kha rgyan rdo rje bcas thogs te/ de nas byabs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ rma bya'i sgro mdangs ku sha bcas kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po yig brgya'i sngags phreng dkar pos bskor ba des byabs pa la brten nas nyams chag nad gdon sogs bkrus pa'i lhag ma cung zad yod pa rnams kyang rdo khab len gyis khab len pa'am/ shel sbur len gyis sbur len pa ltar blangs nas phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po la dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ zhes dang / yig brgya'i mthar/ dmigs yul gyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes nas/ gyur pa thams cad a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar sbyar la byabs/ kha'i chu snod du dor/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i phyag gi rdo rjes lus kyi gnas rnams su gtugs pa la brten nas gnas de dang der rdo rje dmar po mtshal gyis par btab pa bzhin byung bas phyin chad nyams chag nad gdon sogs las bsrung bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang yig brgya bzlas mthar spyi bo mdun rgyab dpung gnyis su gnyis re gnas bdun dang mthar lus thams cad la rdo rje 'jog tshul byas la/

dmigs yul gyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes pa nas/ gyur pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa'i bar sbyar/ slar yang rdo rje spyi bor bzung ste yig brgya'i mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /bcom ldan rdo rje sems pa'i nus mthu yis/ /'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dang / bkra shis kyi tshig brjod/ mchod dkyil du bum pa bzhag la mchod kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs 'bul tshul gong bzhin/ yid brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa sogs/ nongs pa bzod gsol tshigs bcad lhug rgyun bzhin/ bum pa'i ye shes pa/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas/ badz+ra mu/ ye shes pa gshegs/ rang gi gnas rnams su zhes sogs yab yum gyi go cha dang / pū dza oṃ āḥsogs go cha chen po bkod/ mtshams brngam sngags bsrungs/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad/ /sogs/ dag pa gsum dran/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang / srid pa gsum bar sogs/ lha mo tshad ma sogs/ bsngo smon bkra shis/ gang zhig sogs bkra shis bya'o/ /zhag sbrel nas bsgrub na bzod gsol kyi rjes su/ bdag dang 'gro la/ sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pas brtan bzhugs zhag gzhan 'dra'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa sbyin sreg ni/ dmigs yul de'i drung ngam gzhan du'ang rung / snod gtsang mar me gtsang dang spro na de'i drung chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod bsham/ rang thun mtshams he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ snod me bcas/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/

dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang am̐ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog ces pa nas gsang ba'i mchod pa'i bar gong bzhin/ dmigs yul gyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sdig pa'i sa bon snying gar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ zhes dang / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis til mer bsreg cing / bde mchog yab yum gyi zhal du gsol bas dmigs yul gyi sdig pa dag par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig sogs kyis bsregs la/ bcom ldan 'das dmigs yul gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang mchod pa gong bzhin yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa sh+lau ka gcig oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas/ badz+ra muḥthab kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yi sogs gong bzhin no/ /zhes gsung ngag pod dmar ma'i gras yig brgya'i las tshogs las khrus dang sbyin sreg gsal byed 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sdig can nged rang dang 'dra ba rnams kyi sdig sbyongs su bris pa'i dge bas sems can kun gyi sdig pa dag nas bde ba mchog la reg par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gsungs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i khrus dang sbyin sreg PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
